To: Tiffany Munoz
Cc: Richard Henderson

I am opening this thread so you have our status on the licensing diligence for {{fact:f:E-2025-001.client}} in one place as the review moves. We have the matter open and the work under way, and I want you to be able to follow it from a single thread instead of a scatter of separate notes. Right now we are fixing exactly what we are clearing and completing the document set, before we read anything against it.

To keep the scope right, we need the current deal documents from your side: the draft agreements, the patents and applications they turn on, and any assignments or side letters that bear on the rights you would be acquiring. Anything we do not have, we will log and request up front, so the set is complete before we start reading against it. Richard Henderson is standing up the reference set as those materials come in, so we will be working from the right target and not from a guess.

If a short call is easier than pulling the documents together, send me two or three times this week and I will set one up. Settling the scope of the Price-Henson review is the one thing holding the next step, and everything after it follows quickly once we have it.
